# QR Studio Local

> QR Studio Local is a privacy-first, browser-only tool for creating and
> scanning QR codes and other barcodes. Generation, image processing, scanning,
> and structured-data decoding happen locally on the user's device.

QR Studio Local is a static website with no accounts, backend, uploads, or
server-side processing.

The generator supports QR, PDF417, Aztec, UPC-A, EAN-13, Code 128, GS1 DataBar,
Data Matrix, and Micro QR images, with PNG and SVG export.

The reader supports QR, Micro QR, Aztec, Data Matrix, PDF417, UPC/EAN, Code 39,
Code 93, Code 128, Codabar, ITF, and DataBar. Users can scan with a camera or
choose, drag, or paste an image. Difficult still images can be retried with
local sharpening, thresholding, inversion, and rotation recovery.

The reader can decode IATA Bar Coded Boarding Pass data from supported 2D codes
and AAMVA Card Design Standard DL/ID data from compatible PDF417 codes. Raw
encoded content is shown alongside decoded fields.

## Website

- [QR Studio Local](https://qrlocal.songming.org/): Create and scan supported
  visual codes locally in a web browser.
- [Privacy information](https://qrlocal.songming.org/#privacy): Summary of the
  site's on-device processing and no-upload design.
